----
 
 
 

Chloe Cerise (Japanese: サクラギ・コハル Koharu Sakuragi ) is a major supporting character and one of in . She lives in Vermilion City with her family and attends a school there as well. Chloe is also a childhood friend of Goh.

==In animation==
===History===
====Pre-series====
 
Chloe grew up in Vermilion City in the Kanto region with her parents, Professor Cerise and Talia, and younger brother, Parker. Sometime later, Chloe met Goh and became close friends. Chloe also came to know Chrysa and Ren, as well as Laxton, a former student of her father.
 
As revealed in There's a New Kid in Town!, Chloe's family received a as a gift from a friend of Professor Cerise in Galar region. Yamper instantly took a liking to Chloe, but she initially hated him, eventually telling him to go away. When she overheard her parents talking about Yamper's disappearance, she became regretful of her words and sneaked out to look for him. While searching, she was scared by a group of , but Yamper appeared and scared the Pokémon away. From this point on, Yamper grew even more attached to Chloe, accepting food or battle commands only from her, and Chloe also grew to like Yamper.

As seen in Enter Pikachu!, when she was six, Chloe invited Goh to attend 's Pokémon Summer Camp with her. During their visit in Pallet Town, Chloe and Goh encountered the Mythical Pokémon, . The two chased after the unknown Pokémon, but it eventually got away in the aftermath of a baby rescue. Professor Oak later told them the Pokémon they saw was most likely the Mythical Pokémon Mew.
 

====Pokémon Journeys: The Series====
 
In Legend? Go! Friends? Go!, a few years later, during the opening of the Cerise Laboratory, Chloe found Ash passed out after Yamper knocked him down with an attack. However, she discreetly left him lying on the stairs. She later formally introduced herself to Ash when she handed over schoolwork to Goh.

In Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!, the students in Chloe's class participated in an exercise where they discussed their dreams for the future. Chloe became frustrated when her classmates immediately assumed she wanted to be a Pokémon Professor purely because her father is one. She received encouragement from Talia, who told Chloe that she was still young and had plenty of time to decide what she wanted to do with her life. Later, Chloe returned to the laboratory only to find it under attack by a . By commanding Yamper to battle for the first time, Chloe successfully drove Gengar out of the building.

In Dreams Are Made of These!, Chloe accompanied Goh and some children during a Pokémon Orienteering competition. During the event, Goh and Chloe talked about the former's future and his goal to capture all of the Pokémon in the world.

 
In There's a New Kid in Town!, Chloe's family found an injured and let it recuperate at their house. Due to its attachment towards Chloe, Yamper became jealous of Pidove whenever Chloe gave it attention. Despite this, when Pidove was threatened by a wild , Yamper put his jealousy aside and teamed up with Chloe to battle and defeat the Beak Pokémon, forcing it to flee. Afterwards, Chloe and her family said farewell to Pidove after its came to the house to retrieve it.

In The Cuteness Quotient!, after receiving a call from Parker to help his friend Jinny, Chloe asked Ash and Goh to find out how Jinny could explore the beauty of her . To improve their skills, Jinny signed up for the Friendship Festival. While Ash and Goh trained the Pokémon, Chloe helped the girl on how to swim. Later, Chloe, Parker, Ash, and Goh traveled to Hoenn to watch Jinny participate in the competition.

In Restore and Renew!, Chloe went with Ash and Goh to the Pewter Museum of Science to work on a research project for school. Despite her initial reluctance, Chloe became motivated to join the search for fossils at the museum after a passionate lecture from the museum's curator. 

In Crowning the Chow Crusher!, Chloe attends a Pokémon Grand Eating Contest with Chrysa and her father to watch Ash and Goh, who were participating. Although she was reluctant to come at first, Chloe ends up becoming perception and enthusiastic about the competition as it progresses. When Chloe watches Goh's Skwovet evolve into , she finally joins the crowd in celebrating Goh's victory.

In To Train, or Not to Train!, Chloe was attending school alongside Goh when she noticed Yamper barking outside. Chloe went out to investigate to find Yamper was helping to hide an from two people. Thinking they were bad people, Chloe helped Yamper protect Eevee, only to encounter who had captured the Pokémon belonging to her classmates. Chloe commanded Yamper to attack and with help from Eevee was able to defeat . Later, Chloe learnt the people after Eevee were lab assistants at a Research Center regarding Eevee and her Evolutions. They were taking Eevee back with them when the Evolution Pokémon indicated that she wanted to stay with Chloe. Goh gave Chloe one of his Poké Balls which she used to catch Eevee. Later, her dad gave her a pink Rotom Phone.

 
In The Tale of You and Glimwood Tangle!, Chloe travels to Galar to meet a and , after reading a book about them, with Ash and Goh accompanying her. However, upon arriving at Glimwood Tangle, Chloe gets separated from her friends, but encounters a Galarian Ponyta and follows the Unique Horn Pokémon. After catching up to Ponyta, Chloe sees that a Galarian Rapidash is injured and decided to tend to it. Chloe remembers that in the book she read before has information about a rainbow flower that might heal Rapidash, and goes to get its nectar with and Ponyta joining her. After getting the flower nectar, Chloe gives it to Rapidash, but it wasn’t enough to heal the Unique Horn Pokémon, until Eevee and Ponyta use together to help it recover. Chloe and Eevee were given a ride to Ballonlea by the two Unique Horn Pokémon, then reunites with Ash and Goh.

In Memories of a Warming Kindness!, Chloe stays at Chrysa's place for a sleepover. While at Chrysa's place, Chloe finds a picture of her with a and a with a scruff around its neck. After hearing how those two helped Chrysa become a researcher, Chloe believes that she has a crush on him, and goes to Ash and Goh for help in reuniting them, after finding out that they meet the Trainer and his Psyduck. However, Chloe becomes annoyed when she finds out that Chrysa only wanted to see the Trainer’s Psyduck again.

In On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, Chloe travels to Hoenn to meet Kiley, a friend of Chrysa, when she decided to learn about , one of Eevee's many evolved forms. At Kiley's suggestion, Chloe decided to participate alongside Eevee in the Kids Marine Athletics Race. During competition preparation time, Chloe talks a lot with Kiley about her goals and Eevee’s. The next day, during the competition, Chloe and Eevee find that Goh's Dewgong is being attacked by a wild . While trying to escape from Huntail, they take shelter in a cave, but the entrances ends up collapsing. Eventually, they were saved by Ash and Kiley. After everything is resolved, Kiley hands Chloe a Water Stone for her to use on her Eevee if she decides to become a Vaporeon.

 
In Errand Endurance!, Chloe and Goh get into an argument about whether Eevee or was better. Through Ash suggested, they decided to have Eevee and Grookey deliver supplements to the Cerise Laboratory. During the errand, Chloe, Goh, and Ash watched Eevee and Grookey secretly, while helping them out along the way. Eventually, Chloe and Goh were relieved that their partners made it back to the Laboratory safely.

In Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe decided to travel to Sinnoh with Eevee, after a planned vacation with her family got canceled. During the trip, Chloe and Eevee decided to check out a Pokémon Contest in Eterna City. Along the way, Chloe and Eevee camped at a forest for the night where they meet a girl named and her partner , who they quickly befriended. Also, after hearing that she was going to the same destination as she was, Chloe decided to accompany Dawn to Eterna City. Later, Chloe and Dawn worked together to fight off an enraged that had been sleep-deprived due to 's nightmares, before coming across an injured .

 
In the next episode, Chloe helped Dawn take care of Cresselia until she recovered. Also, Chloe was shown by Dawn on how to perform in a Pokémon Contest. After getting attacked by Team Rocket and getting saved by Darkrai, Chloe met up with Ash and Goh, surprised that Ash and Dawn know each other. Together, they fought off Matori and the Matori Matrix, and were aided by Darkrai. Once Team Rocket had been defeated, Chloe and the others played on a beach before going to see Dawn's Contest.

In Night and Day, You are the Ones!, Chloe accompanied Ash and Goh to the Johto region, where they visited the Eclipse Castle. Whilst there, Chloe ran into Soleil, who was her doppelgänger, and her and . They changed clothes, only for Chloe to get kidnapped by Ilunas, who mistook her for Soleil. After being found by Ash and Goh, Chloe battled Ilunas alongside Soleil and defeated him.

In Breaking the Ice!, Chloe was walking to school with Ash and Goh, who joined her for a presentation for their school. Here, she saw a girl named Regina playing with her nicknamed Mirche. Regina was an early new student at school and Chloe wanted to befriend her, but discovered that Regina's Glaceon tended to freeze everything that could be a threat to its Trainer. However, after solving everything for Regina and her Glaceon, Chloe and her friends worked together to make an ice playground for her classmates to play in.

 
In The Gates of Warp!, Chloe accompanied Ash and Goh to Sinnoh to help Dawn find her Piplup. At the Canalave Library, she met for the first time. Due to Alternate World Team Rocket's interference, she and Ash reached to the Canalave City, where she met a person looking exactly like Ash. In the next episode, she accompanied Ash, Goh, and Dawn to Mount Coronet, to try to stop the fight between and and met her alternate self. Due to the reversion of time, Chloe and her friends were reverted back to toddlers, but soon returned to their original forms after the ending of the fight. Chloe then bid farewell to other Chloe and returned back to their world.

In Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, Chloe decided to go to the Celadon Gym with her Eevee to attend the Pokémon Flower Arrangement, only for Ash and Goh to join as well. There, she met the Gym Leader Erika and her . During the class, she decorated her Eevee the same way Leafeon was. 

In Out of Their Elements!, Chloe accompanied Ash and Goh to a Pokémon Circus performance, where she met and . She witnessed the Evolution of their respective Eevee into and . Later, Chloe and Eevee participated in the Pokémon Circus performance, after which Harmony and Billy gave her a Fire Stone and Thunder Stone, respectively.

 
In Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe headed to Lilycove City to meet a , only to be scouted by Lisia to appear in a Pokémon Contest Spectacular. After some encouragement from and her , Chloe and Eevee entered into a Pokémon Contest Spectacular, where Eevee used a combination of , Sylveon's , and , and was well received. Chloe then bid farewell to Serena and met up with Ash and Goh, surprised that Ash and Serena know each other.

In Helping the Hometown Hero!, Chloe joined Ash and Goh during a trip to Alola. During the visit, she talked with regarding what form she was planning to evolve Sandy into, given that she herself was still unsure which of them to choose for her own Eevee. Lana opened Chloe's eyes to the possibility of not evolving her Eevee at all, which Chloe had not considered before.

 
In Infinite Possibilities!, Chloe joined her father, along with the rest of her family, on a camping trip. Along the way, Chloe and her father stopped by in a forest where Professor Cerise had played as a child and met the forest caretaker Grover, who had watched after Cerise during his childhood visits to the forest. At the campsite, the family heard the sound of in the distance and witnessed an Evolution ritual where they all evolved into . Inspired by this, Chloe later told her father that she wants to learn more about Pokémon Evolution.

In A Flood of Torrential Gains!, Chloe was revealed to have reunited with Dawn and traveled to Galar with her to watch Ash's match against in the Masters Eight Tournament finals. In Partners in Time!, Chloe attended the awards ceremony, after Ash became the winner of the competition and became the new Monarch of the World Coronation Series.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Chloe became a research fellow for her father following Ash and Goh's decision to leave Cerise Laboratory. She only goes during the weekends and still attends school.
 

===Character===
 
Chloe is overly cautious and takes a realistic approach to life. She finds Goh's confidence and big ideas to be irritating and often reminds her friend to mind his manners. She appears distant and indifferent to others, as seen when she tends to ignore Ash, although she would gradually open up and become more friendly towards him. Although reserved and aloof, Chloe does care about her friends and is very protective of them, as shown in The Cuteness Quotient!, when two girls made fun of Jinny, she became so angry that she wanted to fight them in person.

 
Chloe's aloofness appears to stem from her own uncertainty of what goals she wants to pursue, and she is bothered by her classmates assuming she will follow in her father's footsteps and become a Pokémon researcher, and that she must be a good battler. After a conversation with her mother and working together with to defeat an attacking , Chloe appears to grow closer to her Pokémon and become more certain of herself. As a child in There's a New Kid in Town!, Chloe used to be jealous of Yamper as a new household pet due to him getting more attention from her parents than her. When she led him to run away from home, she felt guilty and went out to find him at night. Eventually, she came to like him.

As time passed, Chloe became more and more involved with the Pokémon universe, to the point that she personally asked Goh and Ash for help with the school's work on the Fossil Pokémon or being late for school while paying attention to explaining her father about the Pokémon world in Getting More Than You Battled For!. Ever since she became a Trainer in To Train, or Not to Train!, Chloe opened herself up to new experiences as she becomes adventurous, cheerful, and relaxed.

Chloe has a great relationship with her Eevee, as she enjoys her company. Since meeting in Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe developed a close friendship with her. Chloe also looks up to Dawn for her kindness, passion, and skill as a Pokémon Coordinator. Similarly, Chloe admires for both her wisdom and her skill as a and Coordinator. Chloe quickly became good friends with after meeting her, and was surprised that she had decided to not evolve her Eevee, Sandy.

====Contests====
Chloe has competed in the following Pokémon Contests:
Contest - Appeal Round (Normal Rank; Reuniting for the First Time!)

===Main outfit===
 
Chloe's main outfit is her school uniform, which she was first seen wearing in her debut episode Enter Pikachu!. It consists of a white above-the-knee-length dress with a large collar and a navy blue pattern in the style of an anchor, with a yellow design at the front in the style of a rope, and a broad yellow necktie resembling the end of a rope. She wears a pair of white and navy blue boots, with white straps and yellow fasteners, over a pair of black socks topped with a white stripe. She also carries a small, brown school bag, and almost always has a pink, flower-shaped scrunchie in her long ponytail.

Despite being her most commonly seen outfit in the series, the only occurrence of Chloe traveling to another region while wearing her school uniform was in The Cuteness Quotient!.

===Other outfits===
====Formal outfits====
In Night and Day, You are the Ones!, while disguised as Soleil, Chloe wore a yellow kimono with orange accents, and a red obi belt.
In Out of Their Elements!, for her circus performance with , Chloe wore an indigo dress, with pink frills, covered by a short white blazer. She also wore a white, mini top hat, long black socks, and white boots.
In Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe's Pokémon Contest Spectacular dress consisted of a short, pink and purple top with white sleeves, and a pink strap crossed around her neck as a choker. She also wore a pink fluted tutu, over pink shorts with a yellow trim. She wore pink, hooped shoes with dark pink bows, and her other accessories consisted of white earrings and a pink bow with complementary-colored ribbons in addition.

====Casual clothes====
In the later seasons of , Chloe dressed in casual clothing more often, as she joined and Goh on their journeys. She often wore these outfits on several occasions throughout the series.

In several episodes including There's a New Kid in Town!, Sleuths for Truth! and Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, Chloe wore a pink, knee-length dungarees dress with a white shirt underneath, white socks, and brown shoes.

In Restore and Renew!, How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm? and The Gates of Warp!, and other episodes, Chloe dressed casually in yellow dungarees and a grey striped top, with pink socks, and black and white shoes.

On several occasions including A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That! and Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe dressed casually in a salmon pink shirt with a white floral design, light blue trousers, a yellow cardigan knotted around her waist, and pink shoes.

In Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe traveled to the Sinnoh region wearing the casual attire of a white top with a frilly bottom, baggy blue trousers with pink bottoms, brown shoes and a brown cap, and a brown rucksack.

Chloe dressed in casual clothing when starting her journey as a research fellow in This Could be the Start of Something Big!. Her outfit consisted of a white short-sleeved top, a blue skirt, and a pink neck tie, as well as pink shoes and white socks, and a light brown backpack.

====Sleepwear====
In Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!, Chloe wore a white nightdress with a small, pink bow at the front, and pink shorts.

In Restore and Renew!, Chloe wore a pale yellow night shirt with maroon buttons, with a maroon Poké Ball symbol on the pocket, and with matching trousers and slippers.

In How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm? and Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe wore a light pink pajama shirt with darker pink trims and heart-shaped buttons, and light pink pajama trousers.

====Winter wear====
In Memories of a Warming Kindness!, Chloe is seen wearing a cream cardigan over her regular school uniform.
In The Homecoming Crown!, while searching the Crown Tundra with and Goh, Chloe wore a pink snow jacket and trousers, with a cream-colored hat and gloves, and had a brown backpack.

====Swimwear====
In The Cuteness Quotient!, Chloe wore a white two-piece bikini, with a pink bow on the top piece, and a pink flower print on the bottom piece.

In On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, Chloe wore a claret wetsuit with pink shoulders and sides, black wetsuit shoes, and pink goggles, to compete in the Marine Athletic Race.

====Other clothing====
Chloe dressed as a farmer in How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm?, wearing yellow overalls, a light green shirt, and white gloves, along with a sand-brown stetson, and pink wellies with black stripes.

Due to Alternate World Team Rocket's interference, she and Ash reached to the Canalave City, where she met a person looking exactly like Ash. In the next episode, she accompanied Ash, Goh, and Dawn to Mount Coronet, to try to stop the fight between and and met her alternate self. Due to the reversion of time, Chloe and her friends were reverted back to toddlers, but soon returned to their original forms after the ending of the fight. Chloe then bid farewell to other Chloe and returned back to their world.

In Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, Chloe decided to go to the Celadon Gym with her Eevee to attend the Pokémon Flower Arrangement, only for Ash and Goh to join as well. There, she met the Gym Leader Erika and her . During the class, she decorated her Eevee the same way Leafeon was. 

In Out of Their Elements!, Chloe accompanied Ash and Goh to a Pokémon Circus performance, where she met and . She witnessed the Evolution of their respective Eevee into and . Later, Chloe and Eevee participated in the Pokémon Circus performance, after which Harmony and Billy gave her a Fire Stone and Thunder Stone, respectively.

 
In Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe headed to Lilycove City to meet a , only to be scouted by Lisia to appear in a Pokémon Contest Spectacular. After some encouragement from and her , Chloe and Eevee entered into a Pokémon Contest Spectacular, where Eevee used a combination of , Sylveon's , and , and was well received. Chloe then bid farewell to Serena and met up with Ash and Goh, surprised that Ash and Serena know each other.

In Helping the Hometown Hero!, Chloe joined Ash and Goh during a trip to Alola. During the visit, she talked with regarding what form she was planning to evolve Sandy into, given that she herself was still unsure which of them to choose for her own Eevee. Lana opened Chloe's eyes to the possibility of not evolving her Eevee at all, which Chloe had not considered before.

 
In Infinite Possibilities!, Chloe joined her father, along with the rest of her family, on a camping trip. Along the way, Chloe and her father stopped by in a forest where Professor Cerise had played as a child and met the forest caretaker Grover, who had watched after Cerise during his childhood visits to the forest. At the campsite, the family heard the sound of in the distance and witnessed an Evolution ritual where they all evolved into . Inspired by this, Chloe later told her father that she wants to learn more about Pokémon Evolution.

In A Flood of Torrential Gains!, Chloe was revealed to have reunited with Dawn and traveled to Galar with her to watch Ash's match against in the Masters Eight Tournament finals. In Partners in Time!, Chloe attended the awards ceremony, after Ash became the winner of the competition and became the new Monarch of the World Coronation Series.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Chloe became a research fellow for her father following Ash and Goh's decision to leave Cerise Laboratory. She only goes during the weekends and still attends school.

sections.heading: Character
sections.text:
Chloe is overly cautious and takes a realistic approach to life. She finds Goh's confidence and big ideas to be irritating and often reminds her friend to mind his manners. She appears distant and indifferent to others, as seen when she tends to ignore Ash, although she would gradually open up and become more friendly towards him. Although reserved and aloof, Chloe does care about her friends and is very protective of them, as shown in The Cuteness Quotient!, when two girls made fun of Jinny, she became so angry that she wanted to fight them in person.

 
Chloe's aloofness appears to stem from her own uncertainty of what goals she wants to pursue, and she is bothered by her classmates assuming she will follow in her father's footsteps and become a Pokémon researcher, and that she must be a good battler. After a conversation with her mother and working together with to defeat an attacking , Chloe appears to grow closer to her Pokémon and become more certain of herself. As a child in There's a New Kid in Town!, Chloe used to be jealous of Yamper as a new household pet due to him getting more attention from her parents than her. When she led him to run away from home, she felt guilty and went out to find him at night. Eventually, she came to like him.

As time passed, Chloe became more and more involved with the Pokémon universe, to the point that she personally asked Goh and Ash for help with the school's work on the Fossil Pokémon or being late for school while paying attention to explaining her father about the Pokémon world in Getting More Than You Battled For!. Ever since she became a Trainer in To Train, or Not to Train!, Chloe opened herself up to new experiences as she becomes adventurous, cheerful, and relaxed.

Chloe has a great relationship with her Eevee, as she enjoys her company. Since meeting in Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe developed a close friendship with her. Chloe also looks up to Dawn for her kindness, passion, and skill as a Pokémon Coordinator. Similarly, Chloe admires for both her wisdom and her skill as a and Coordinator. Chloe quickly became good friends with after meeting her, and was surprised that she had decided to not evolve her Eevee, Sandy.

sections.heading: Main outfit
sections.text:
Chloe's main outfit is her school uniform, which she was first seen wearing in her debut episode Enter Pikachu!. It consists of a white above-the-knee-length dress with a large collar and a navy blue pattern in the style of an anchor, with a yellow design at the front in the style of a rope, and a broad yellow necktie resembling the end of a rope. She wears a pair of white and navy blue boots, with white straps and yellow fasteners, over a pair of black socks topped with a white stripe. She also carries a small, brown school bag, and almost always has a pink, flower-shaped scrunchie in her long ponytail.

Despite being her most commonly seen outfit in the series, the only occurrence of Chloe traveling to another region while wearing her school uniform was in The Cuteness Quotient!.

sections.heading: Formal outfits
sections.text:
In Night and Day, You are the Ones!, while disguised as Soleil, Chloe wore a yellow kimono with orange accents, and a red obi belt.
In Out of Their Elements!, for her circus performance with , Chloe wore an indigo dress, with pink frills, covered by a short white blazer. She also wore a white, mini top hat, long black socks, and white boots.
In Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe's Pokémon Contest Spectacular dress consisted of a short, pink and purple top with white sleeves, and a pink strap crossed around her neck as a choker. She also wore a pink fluted tutu, over pink shorts with a yellow trim. She wore pink, hooped shoes with dark pink bows, and her other accessories consisted of white earrings and a pink bow with complementary-colored ribbons in addition.

sections.heading: Casual clothes
sections.text:
In the later seasons of , Chloe dressed in casual clothing more often, as she joined and Goh on their journeys. She often wore these outfits on several occasions throughout the series.

In several episodes including There's a New Kid in Town!, Sleuths for Truth! and Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, Chloe wore a pink, knee-length dungarees dress with a white shirt underneath, white socks, and brown shoes.

In Restore and Renew!, How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm? and The Gates of Warp!, and other episodes, Chloe dressed casually in yellow dungarees and a grey striped top, with pink socks, and black and white shoes.

On several occasions including A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That! and Reuniting for the First Time!, Chloe dressed casually in a salmon pink shirt with a white floral design, light blue trousers, a yellow cardigan knotted around her waist, and pink shoes.

In Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe traveled to the Sinnoh region wearing the casual attire of a white top with a frilly bottom, baggy blue trousers with pink bottoms, brown shoes and a brown cap, and a brown rucksack.

Chloe dressed in casual clothing when starting her journey as a research fellow in This Could be the Start of Something Big!. Her outfit consisted of a white short-sleeved top, a blue skirt, and a pink neck tie, as well as pink shoes and white socks, and a light brown backpack.

sections.heading: Sleepwear
sections.text:
In Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!, Chloe wore a white nightdress with a small, pink bow at the front, and pink shorts.

In Restore and Renew!, Chloe wore a pale yellow night shirt with maroon buttons, with a maroon Poké Ball symbol on the pocket, and with matching trousers and slippers.

In How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm? and Nightfall? Nightmares!, Chloe wore a light pink pajama shirt with darker pink trims and heart-shaped buttons, and light pink pajama trousers.

sections.heading: Winter wear
sections.text:
In Memories of a Warming Kindness!, Chloe is seen wearing a cream cardigan over her regular school uniform.
In The Homecoming Crown!, while searching the Crown Tundra with and Goh, Chloe wore a pink snow jacket and trousers, with a cream-colored hat and gloves, and had a brown backpack.

sections.heading: Swimwear
sections.text:
In The Cuteness Quotient!, Chloe wore a white two-piece bikini, with a pink bow on the top piece, and a pink flower print on the bottom piece.

In On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!, Chloe wore a claret wetsuit with pink shoulders and sides, black wetsuit shoes, and pink goggles, to compete in the Marine Athletic Race.

sections.heading: Other clothing
sections.text: Chloe dressed as a farmer in How Are You Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm?, wearing yellow overalls, a light green shirt, and white gloves, along with a sand-brown stetson, and pink wellies with black stripes.
